summary: Costamare Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 30, 2026, announcing quarterly cash dividends on its preferred and common stock. The company declared US$0.476563 per Series B, US$0.531250 per Series C, and US$0.546875 per Series D preferred share for the July 15 to October 14, 2026 period, payable October 15 to holders of record October 14. It also declared US$0.125 per common share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, payable November 5 to holders of record October 20. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation.
